answer: Identity weight comes from sunk cost, not credentials: an agent mints an identity by streaming a bond into escrow at a rate it cannot accelerate, and its weight accumulates like sediment building a terrace, one layer per epoch. A jade token marks the escrowed stake, burned on any equivocation. The attacker's cost is capital times time: every fake identity needs a separately funded bond locked for many epochs, and one double-vote burns it. A thousand sybils cost a thousand slow deposits, while the river of honest weight keeps rising past them.
